name: Women's Health Research Day 2027
organizer: University of Illinois College of Medicine Chicago
venue: University of Illinois College of Medicine Chicago
description: Women's Health Research Day is an annual research symposium at the University of Illinois College of Medicine Chicago with a call for abstracts open to students, fellows, faculty, and staff, judged oral abstract presentations, and a poster symposium. The eighth annual edition was held April 29, 2026, with ninety two poster submissions; the ninth edition had not been scheduled as of September 2026.

sources.note: 8th annual Women's Health Research Day held April 29, 2026, keynote Dr. George Saade, 92 poster submissions, call for abstracts confirmed

notes: The 2027 date was not yet published; based on only one confirmed prior year, no day-level estimate is given for the next edition.
